Lists/sports: establish universe/time. Clarify genuinely ambiguous sport/entity before unresolved time scope. Do not re-ask settled scope without concrete conflict. Explicitly current uses host date; historical cutoffs need status THEN, not today's page. Verify entrants, results, transfers, and the whole set for completeness. Changed sport/season/cutoff/competition invalidates only affected scope/evidence/results; retain unaffected choices and verify the replacement scope at its requested time. Never silently choose a season; report coverage limits.
